correctness.rationale: Independently enumerated normalized coprime homogeneous pairs: degree four in characteristic three implies separability. Every repeated point in a quartic fiber over a rational value has residue degree at most two, so the entire rational-branch filter is exact using local fiber expansions over F9, including the point at infinity. It gives 17,496 maps, none with four rational branch values and rational multiplicity lists consistent with tameness and the different bound, and 864 candidates with three (576 dihedral-profile, 96 Klein-profile, 192 simple-profile). The five explicit PGL2(F3)^2 orbits are disjoint, exhaust the candidates, and have sizes 288,288,72,24,192 and hence stabilizers 2,2,8,24,3. Direct expansions over F9 and F27 at the representatives account for all six different units in each case with indices 2 or 4, proving tameness by Riemann–Hurwitz. In the last orbit the six distinct branch values include three degree-three conjugates; alternatively, the cubic critical orbit cannot have rational image because that would put three double points in one degree-four fiber. For monodromy no positive-characteristic product-one presentation is needed: the dihedral maps factor through x^2 and hence their geometric monodromy lies in the order-eight imprimitive group; it contains a 4-cycle and a transposition, hence equals that group. In the Klein cases all inertia permutations are double transpositions and the normal subgroup generated by all inertia is the whole geometric group, since a nontrivial unramified quotient cover of the geometric projective line is impossible. The resulting transitive subgroup of V4 is V4. The same normal-generation argument makes the simple-branch case a transitive group generated by transpositions, so S4. The independently written exact replay is /workspace/review-evidence/quartic.py; the frozen scripts and logged counts were inspected, not executed.
